exposure: transcervical Foley catheter plus oxytocin infusion
cohort: Pregnant women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) between 24(0/7) and 36(6/7) weeks' gestation and an unfavorable cervical examination
finding: In patients with PPROM, the use of a transcervical Foley catheter in addition to oxytocin is not associated with a shorter time to delivery compared with oxytocin alone.
